statements.proposition: This change (re)writes the field_validator imports so that field_validator is imported with a fallback to pydantic v1's validator.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: At head, all three modified files import field_validator in a try block with `except ImportError: from pydantic import validator as field_validator`. A v1 fallback already existed at base; the change splits BaseModel/Field/ValidationError out of the try block so only field_validator (and ConfigDict) is guarded. The import with v1 compatibility is present and was edited in this change; whether 'adding' compatibility is new is a judgment (it pre-existed).
evidence: gh api repos/DannyMac180/meta-agent/pulls/170/files: modified guardrail_generator.py, spec_schema.py, tool_spec_parser.py
Each patch: `try: from pydantic import field_validator` / `except ImportError:  # Pydantic v1` / `from pydantic import validator as field_validator`
Base side of patch already had `except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - pydantic v1 fallback ... validator as field_validator`
